description: Type invoice line-item subtotal as a string. The spec declares PaginatedLineItem data[].subtotal as type: number, but GET /v1/organizations/{org}/invoices/{id}/line-items returns it as a stringified decimal, like the invoice total the spec already types as a string. Observed on the live API 2026-09-30: every line item's subtotal was a JSON string holding a decimal.

patches.value: The total for the line item, as a stringified decimal to preserve precision
